QuestInfo.name: Once Loyal, Twice Evil
QuestInfo.1: Enter the crack and find the link between the Crack in Time, Arkarium, and the Mystic Gates.
QuestInfo.2: You were able to defeat Arkarium, pontifex of the goddess, who betrayed her to become the Black Mage's commander.
QuestInfo.0: The Crack in Time has appeared in the Temple of Time! Go investigate it in person.

0.msg: This must be the crack. The puzzle must be solved if we're going to save Maple World. Arkarium, the Mystic Gates, the Crack in Time...

1.msg: (Alpha, from here... I can feel it. A very powerful...)

2.msg: (Yes, I felt it too. Time is being twisted by an incredible power.)

3.msg: They say you have to enter the lion's den if you want to catch a lion. Maybe you should enter the crack in time...

4.msg: Crow and Starling are preparing for this new mission. Are you ready?

yes.0: Enter the crack. If you find Arkarium inside... just be safe. Take the portal to the right and take care of yourself.

no.0: How can you hesitate at a time like this? If Arkarium is involved, the fate of Maple World could hang in the balance! Talk to to me when your heart is in the right place.
